paper.title_en: Contrasting one- and two-particle excitations in cuprate strange metals
paper.abstract_en: In unconventional superconductivity, the pairing mechanism remains one of the central unresolved problems in solid-state physics. Moreover, the normal state shows strong deviations from conventional Fermi-liquid behavior, most notably a scattering rate that is linear in energy and temperature. Here we study the momentum dependence of the energy and damping of collective excitations in optimally doped cuprates in the normal state. In particular, we analyze existing Electron Energy Loss Spectroscopy (EELS) data of Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8 [Phys. Rev. B 44, 7155 (1991)] and new analogous optical plasmon data of Bi2Sr2Ca2Cu3O10. Furthermore, we reanalyze similar Resonant Inelastic Xray Scattering (RIXS) acoustic plasmon data [Phys. Rev. R 6, 043184 (2024)] of La1.84Sr0.16CuO4 and La1.84Ce0.16CuO4. We contrast these two-particle excitation results with one-particle excitations measured by Angle-Resolved Photoemission Spectroscopy (ARPES). Most of the plasmon behavior can be described well by combined self-energies of a hole and an electron. The dispersion of optical plasmons at high energy is only weakly determined by correlation effects, indicating resilient quasiparticles. The damping of the optical plasmons at low energy, however, is strongly influenced by the reduced scattering rates described in the marginal Fermi liquid model for "strange-metal" behavior. In addition, the same model describes the linear-in-energy damping of acoustic plasmons. Contrary to some theoretical predictions, we see no overdamped optical plasmons below the classical Lindhard critical wave vector.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 研究铜氧化物奇异金属中单粒子与两粒子激发的动量依赖性，将EELS、光学等离激元和RIXS声学等离激元数据与ARPES结果对比，并用边际费米液体模型解释阻尼行为，与全息凝聚态物质（奇异金属）主题直接相关，实验与模型对照清晰，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 铜氧化物奇异金属中单粒子与两粒子激发的对比
decision.abstract_zh: 在非常规超导中，配对机制仍然是固态物理中尚未解决的核心问题之一。此外，其正常态表现出对常规费米液体行为的强烈偏离，最显著的是散射率在能量和温度上呈线性。本文研究最优掺杂铜氧化物正常态中集体激发能量与阻尼的动量依赖性。具体而言，我们分析了Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8已有的电子能量损失谱（EELS）数据[Phys. Rev. B 44, 7155 (1991)]以及Bi2Sr2Ca2Cu3O10新的类似光学等离激元数据。此外，我们重新分析了La1.84Sr0.16CuO4和La1.84Ce0.16CuO4类似的共振非弹性X射线散射（RIXS）声学等离激元数据[Phys. Rev. R 6, 043184 (2024)]。我们将这些两粒子激发结果与角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）测量的单粒子激发进行对比。大多数等离激元行为可由空穴与电子自能的组合很好地描述。高能光学等离激元的色散仅微弱地由关联效应决定，表明准粒子具有稳健性。然而，低能光学等离激元的阻尼受到边际费米液体模型中描述的、“奇异金属”行为下降低的散射率的强烈影响。此外，同一模型描述了声学等离激元的线性于能量的阻尼。与某些理论预测相反，我们在经典Lindhard临界波矢以下未观察到过阻尼的光学等离激元。
